debug.subtitle: Pick a scene, switch seats, and play at the table.
debug.copyFailed: Copy failed. Copy the scene URL from the address bar.
debug.legalCards: Keeps submitted cards. Only evil players can fail, so the team limits the final count.
debug.latencyHint: Changes the indicator only; local actions stay immediate.
debug.localOnly: Local simulation. Use the controls to switch scenes or advance the game.
debug.disconnected: Simulated offline. Restore the connection in Connection & errors.
debug.simulatedError: Simulated action failure. State is unchanged; try again.

assassinHit.title: Assassination · Merlin hit
assassinHit.description: The dagger strikes, Merlin is revealed and the red team wins. Reset to replay.

assassinMiss.title: Assassination · Miss
assassinMiss.description: The dagger strikes, the target is revealed and the blue team wins. Reset to replay.

role.title: Role reveal
role.description: Reveal a role card; switch seats to inspect each role’s knowledge.

team.title: Team building
team.description: Select seats to build a team, or propose one automatically.

lastProposal.title: Final proposal
lastProposal.description: Four proposals rejected; one more rejection gives evil the win.

voting.title: Voting in progress
voting.description: Some votes are in. Switch seats or complete the remaining votes.

voted.title: Vote submitted
voted.description: Your approval is submitted. Inspect waiting and duplicate-submit prevention.

approved.title: Proposal approved
approved.description: Resolves a unanimous approval automatically. Reset to replay.

rejected.title: Proposal rejected
rejected.description: Resolves a rejection and rotates the leader. Reset to replay.

missionGood.title: Good mission player
missionGood.description: Good players can only submit success. Inspect the locked fail button.

missionEvil.title: Evil mission player
missionEvil.description: Evil players may submit success or fail.

submitted.title: Mission card submitted
submitted.description: The submitted card stays hidden while waiting for the rest of the team.

missionSuccess.title: Mission success
missionSuccess.description: Collects, shuffles, and reveals success cards. Reset to replay.

missionFail.title: Mission failure
missionFail.description: Reveals a mission with a fail card. Reset to replay.

twoFails.title: Round four · Two fails required
twoFails.description: With 7–10 players, round four needs two fails. Try one or two.

lady.title: Lady inspection
lady.description: Choose an eligible player from the Lady holder’s perspective.

ladyGood.title: Lady result · Good
ladyGood.description: Inspect a good result visible only to the examiner.

ladyEvil.title: Lady result · Evil
ladyEvil.description: Inspect an evil result visible only to the examiner.

assassination.title: Assassination after three successes
assassination.description: Three successful missions. The assassin chooses a good player to strike.

earlyAssassination.title: Early assassination
earlyAssassination.description: An early strike before missions finish. Inspect public roles and targets.

goodWins.title: Good wins · Assassin missed
goodWins.description: The assassin missed Merlin. All roles are revealed.

evilWins.title: Evil wins · Merlin assassinated
evilWins.description: After three successful missions, killing Merlin gives evil the win.

threeFails.title: Evil wins · Three failed missions
threeFails.description: Three failed missions end the game immediately.

fiveRejections.title: Evil wins · Five rejections
fiveRejections.description: Five consecutive rejections. Inspect the proposal track and logs.

spectator.title: Spectator
spectator.description: All seats are occupied. Spectators cannot perform player actions.

openSeat.title: Claim an open seat
openSeat.description: Claim the open seat, then reveal that player’s role.

offline.title: Player offline
offline.description: One player is offline with their seat reserved. Toggle it in connection controls.

reconnecting.title: Reconnecting
reconnecting.description: Table actions pause. Restore the connection in the controls to continue.

announcement.title: Team explanation
announcement.description: The leader explains the draft and chooses the speaking direction, then speaks last.

discussion.title: Speaking turns
discussion.description: Each player ends their own turn in seat order.

finalizing.title: Finalize team
finalizing.description: Keep or revise the team, then open voting.

overdue.title: Overdue speech
overdue.description: The speaker can still finish after the reminder expires.
